label: TP
reason: Two genuine vulnerabilities found: Alert 1 (java/xss) has sink at L60-62 where fileName (containing user input via param→bar→fileName) is printed to response.getWriter() - the resolved sink value depends on attacker input. Alert 2 (java/path-injection) has sink at L55 where fileName (initialized to null, then assigned from user input via param→bar→fileName) is used in FileInputStream constructor - the resolved sink value depends on attacker input.

evidence.note: XSS sink: response.getWriter().println() outputs fileName containing user input (via bar variable derived from param)
Path injection sink: fileName variable used in FileInputStream constructor, value derived from user input via bar
